name: TC_U14_E2E_SearchAddThenUpdate
description:
Full cross-endpoint user journey:
  Step 1 — GET /search for 'SON MOI': retrieve product list, pick first id.
  Step 2 — POST /add-to-cart with the first product id (qty=1).
  Step 3 — POST /update-product to change qty to 2.
Asserts each step succeeds independently and the final update returns a non-empty alert_message. Validates the add→update dependency chain.
